page.layout: Top: running head at upper right, page number at upper left. Below them two circular medallion portraits side by side, each with a vertical inscription (left "IEPTB", right "ABZAN"). Below the medallions one column of running text in two paragraphs. A small woodcut ornament at the foot, without text.

main_text.p: IEPHTE, filius Galaad ex meretrice, iudicauit populum Israël anno mundi 2787. ante Christum natum 1175. Hic pugnauit contra Ammonitas, quos tradidit dominus in manus eius. vouerat autem prius, satis tamen imprudenter, se in holocaustum oblaturū domino eum qui primus de domo sua egrediens, sibi occurreret victori: accidítque vt filia sua vnigenita cum tympanis & choris ei reuertenti occurreret, qua visa scidit ipse sua sibi vestimēta, præ dolore: immolauit tamen filiam post duos menses, quos illa impetrarat ad lugendam virginitatem. Vide lib.Iudi.cap.11.& 12.fex annis iudicauit Iephte Israëlem. Ioseph.lib.Antiq.5.cap.12.

ABESAN, de Beth-lehem, mortuo Iephte iudicauit Israël septem annis. Hic habuit triginta filios & totidem filias, quas omnes maritis tradidit, simul filiis omnibus vxores dedit: foras misit filias, filiorum autem vxores domum suam introduxit. Iudi.12. Ioseph.lib.5.cap.12. Rabbi Salomon & Chaldæus paraphrastes hūc Abesan Boos esse dicunt. Post Abesan, Aelon de tribu Zabulon, iudicauit populum annos decem: post quem etiam Abdon de tribu Ephraim, iudicauit Israëlē annos octo. Iudicum cap.12. post hunc Samson iudicauit, cuius meminero postea.

page.notes: Medallion inscriptions are set vertically along the rims; the first letter of the left one is read as B, possibly E, so marked [?]. Woodcut portraits and the ornament carry no further text. Greek and Hebrew: none printed. Marked "Vide lib.Iudi.cap.11.& 12." kept as printed (the reference "fex" is printed as such, probably "sex").
